name: salary slip
script:
employee = frappe.get_doc("Employee", doc.employee) if employee.custom_send_salary_slip == 1: receiver = employee.personal_email or employee.company_email if receiver: # ----- Subject ----- date_str = str(doc.start_date) year = date_str[0:4] month_no = date_str[5:7] month_map = { "01": "January", "02": "February", "03": "March", "04": "April", "05": "May", "06": "June", "07": "July", "08": "August", "09": "September", "10": "October", "11": "November", "12": "December" } subject = f"Your Salary Slip for {month_map.get(month_no, '')} {year}" # ----- Format dates as dd-mm-yy manually ----- def format_ddmmyy(date_str): # date_str is 'YYYY-MM-DD' y = date_str[2:4] # last 2 digits of year m = date_str[5:7] d = date_str[8:10] return f"{d}-{m}-{y}" start_date_formatted = format_ddmmyy(str(doc.start_date)) end_date_formatted = format_ddmmyy(str(doc.end_date)) # ----- HTML Body (3 lines) ----- message = f"""

Dear {doc.employee_name},

Please find attached your Salary Slip ({start_date_formatted} to {end_date_formatted}).

Regards,
Ravi Product.

""" try: pdf = frappe.get_print( "Salary Slip", doc.name, print_format="Salary Slip", as_pdf=True ) frappe.sendmail( recipients=receiver, subject=subject, message=message, attachments=[{ "fname": f"Salary Slip - {doc.employee_name}.pdf", "fcontent": pdf }], now=True ) except Exception as e: frappe.log_error( f"Salary Slip Email Failed\n" f"Slip: {doc.name}\n" f"Employee: {doc.employee}\n" f"{str(e)}", "Salary Slip Email Error" )
